class.name: NNHTNExecutionSettings
class.brief_description: Resource configuring how an [NNHTNRoot] switches plans and recovers from failed steps.
class.description: Assign to [member NNHTNRoot.execution_settings] when you want to customize plan-switching behaviour instead of immediately replacing plans on every replan. Use [member interruption_policy] to let the active step finish first, [member switch_hysteresis] to reduce plan thrashing under ranked search, and [member local_repair] to patch failed plans locally before replanning from scratch.

method.name: get_validation_errors
method.description: Returns error messages for any invalid settings, or an empty array if valid.

members.member: Whether a new plan replaces the running plan right away ([constant IMMEDIATE]) or waits for the current step to finish ([constant FINISH_CURRENT_STEP]).
If [code]true[/code], attempts to repair a failed or invalidated plan around the failed method while preserving completed and remaining steps before falling back to a full replan.

Minimum utility improvement required under [constant NNHTNSearchSettings.RANKED] before replacing a running plan whose current step is still valid. Set to [code]0.0[/code] to switch on any improvement.

constants.constant: Installs the new plan immediately, cancelling the active step unless [member NNHTNTask.resumable] keeps it.
Lets the currently running step finish before switching to the new plan (unless bypassed by an urgent replan or step failure).
